svg.title: NODI complete pin-to-pin harness RevB
svg.text: NODI / full pin-to-pin wiring / revision B
2026-10-25 · actual schematic pin IDs · all hardware untested · local passive wiring: three-sheet KiCad circuit
Lengths below are initial cut allowances, not measured fits. Seven moving wires W14–W20 need ≥80 mm free loop.
destination pin / wire size / cut length
J4 JST XH: mating-face PROJECT cavity numbering; identify molded cavity 1 and continuity-check before inserting contacts.
View from WIRE ENTRY reverses left/right. Use circuit/cavity IDs, not a guessed mirror of a product photograph.
Mating face, project numbers: [1 GND] [2 +5V] [3 SIG]
Stock QT red lead carries 3.3V here. Do not connect servo +5V.
J1 BOB-15100 component-side view, USB socket LEFT:
Header TOP→BOTTOM: 6 VBUS, 5 GND, 4 CC1, 3 D−, 2 D+, 1 CC2.
Current board already has 2 × 5.1k Rd. Do not parallel extra CC resistors.
A1—A2 are common; B1—B2 are common. Press joins A to B.
Wire W25 to A1 and W26 to B1; verify pairs with an ohmmeter.
No arbitrary computer USB port: dedicated 5.0–5.1V / 3A source. Main supply/return20AWG; servo branches24AWG; signal26/28AWG.
J4 header + XHP-7 housing + SXH-001T-P0.6 contacts form an insulated fixed-base disconnect; its retention and exact fit are not modeled.
Carrier-local wiring (R1–R9, C1–C3, D1, Q1 and U2 ties) is fully defined in the native circuit and netlist, not omitted from the electrical design.
Inspect polarity and shorts before power. Center servos with horns removed. Require a physical harness sweep, cable pull test and supply droop test.
SW1 physical top view; rotate to put continuity-identified common pairs at left and right.
Pair A is internally common; pair B is internally common.
No terminal numbering is assumed from an anonymous switch photo.
Use an ohmmeter; pressing must join A to B.
